title: Evaluation after enlarging available coordinates
statement: Let $A\subseteq B$ be sets of available coordinates among $n$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree with labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$. For any input $x$ assigning an alphabet symbol to each coordinate, evaluating $T$ viewed as a tree with the larger available set $B$ gives the same label as evaluating $T$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite sets A and B of coordinates in Fin n with A ⊆ B
A finite decision tree over Ω with labels in α and available set A
An input x : Fin n → Ω
